name: University of Utah Health Salt Lake City Marathon
summary: The Salt Lake City Marathon is held on a Saturday in April. It starts at the Olympic Legacy Bridge and finishes in the heart of downtown. The race site promises views of the Wasatch Mountains and calls the course challenging.
courseHighlights: Start at the Olympic Legacy Bridge
Runs through some of the city's neighbourhoods
Finish in the heart of downtown Salt Lake City

paceStrategy.summary: A race listing calls the course net downhill, while the official site calls it challenging. Check the interactive course map for the elevation profile, and avoid running the early miles too fast.

segments.terrain: Start near the Olympic Legacy Bridge
segments.advice: Hold back; fresh legs and downhill sections tempt you to run fast.

segments.terrain: Neighbourhoods on the way to downtown
segments.advice: Hold goal pace and respect any climbs shown on the map.
Keep your form and finish strong.

fuelingNotes: The race site's text does not list aid stations; open the course maps page for details. At altitude, drink at every opportunity.
tips: The race starts early on a Saturday morning
Salt Lake City is at altitude, so run by effort
The official course maps page has interactive maps for each distance
Check the interactive map because the route may change

faq.question: Is the Salt Lake City Marathon downhill?
faq.answer: A race listing calls it a net downhill course, and the official site calls the course challenging. Check the official elevation profile for details.

faq.question: When is the Salt Lake City Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Saturday in April.

faq.question: Where does the Salt Lake City Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at the Olympic Legacy Bridge and finishes downtown.
